cells.gaps: No source gives a share or count of offices making the entry in Madania: TUN-018 (2020) and TUN-012 (2015) say all offices are interconnected or have access and give no number registering. Nothing on how the record is made or on offices is dated after 2020; no plan whose period includes the as-at and no finance fact inside the 36 months is held (TUN-009 and TUN-020 plans ended by 2021, TUN-019 donor finance is 2021).
cells.note: Births and deaths are entered by the registrar at the municipal office after the paper register and held in the national database (TUN-011, TUN-016), but the offices figure is a share equipped, which places at stage 3. Stage 4 needs a share or a count with a denominator of offices registering.
